intents.response: Hello! I am your outpass assistant. How can I help you today?
To apply for an outpass: Go to Apply Outpass section, fill in your reason, destination, from date and to date. Your warden will review it and forward to your parents for approval.

Outpass Rules: You can apply maximum 2 outpasses per month. You cannot apply if you already have an active outpass. Outpass expires at end of your return date. Make sure to do face scan at gate when leaving and returning.

patterns: how to scan face at gate
intents.response: When your outpass is approved, go to the gate. Warden 2 will scan your face using the webcam. If your face matches, your exit will be logged. Do the same when you return to campus.

patterns: why do parents need to approve
intents.response: After warden reviews your request, emails are sent to all 4 of your registered guardians. Any one of them can approve or reject. Once approved your outpass is granted.
Goodbye! Stay safe and return on time!
